method: Attitude kinematics are propagated using quaternions to avoid gimbal lock; translational and rotational dynamics follow the full nonlinear Newton-Euler rigid-body equations. The inner attitude loop uses cascaded PID; the outer position/velocity loop uses LQR gains from a linearization about hover.
